title: Imperial Harem, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Specific Imperial Harem relation4743322: exact notched multi-court footprint, stepped cream/stone service and apartment ranges, lead hip roofs, principal domed halls, smaller bath domes and chimney groups. Distinct Twin Kiosk frontage faces the mapped Courtyard of the Favourites with open lower pointed arches, striped brick/stone upper work, pale window screens and projecting muted blue-green tiled bay. Keep all three mapped courtyards open and retain independent Tower of Justice, Council Hall and every other palace member. No furnished apartments, copied wall/ceiling art or inscriptions, visitors, pool restoration or invented complete historic room inventory.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Independent Imperial Harem Q133817551 and OSM relation4743322/native52776562876570; parent includes three mapped holes and the apartment/service ranges, but excludes Council Hall/Tower and adjacent independent halls/mosques. Existing PMTiles labels locate Queen Mother court and the external Favourites court. Internal+X follows the range southwest, internal+Z faces northwest toward the outer gardens. World heading0/native+X east,+Z south. Three ordinary exterior/court pictures actually inspected; roof-room assignments not supplied by PMTiles remain an explicitly approximate visual interpretation.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No qualified native architectural height or roof/room subdivision. Picture-led working service eaves8.1-9.5m, Queen Mother/central apartment eaves9.2-9.7m and Twin Kiosk upper cornice12.8m above its local control; dominant hall domes rise4-7m above low drums. Seven principal/representative domes, a compact bath-dome group and chimney placement are footprint-led visual controls, not a surveyed inventory. Twin Kiosk undercroft and upper tile/window/brick proportions are guided by the actual exterior photo. Hidden interiors, exact roof-room assignments, fine ornament and historical thresholds remain unverified.
